desc: PROPOSED ONE-SHOT (step 1 of the stage-2 preflight, done/2026-07-25-t6040-uboot-stage2-prep.md §4): tethered m1n1 chainload of the U-Boot stage-2 payload, INERT BANNER ONLY. Compose chainload image = m1n1 v3 c59d5820 (FB_CONSOLE_ALWAYS, live-proven) + canonical kbuild-built t6040-j614s-dcuart-uboot-stage2.dtb + u-boot-nodtb.bin 2da75ecdf1000cea1af158dc8dbe69ee4a380d7674c3a797186e606215fec846 (550,584 B) + exactly 481,136 zero bytes (Image runtime size 1,031,720; raw payload must be LAST, after the DTB). Push over the working KIS/USB-gadget proxy from the enrolled bare loader 1394c345 — the live-proven payload path; no enrollment of any kind. NOTHING plugged into the right port; no USB stick anywhere. PASS = m1n1 panel log shows payload discovery and jump; U-Boot banner + model line 'J614s [U-Boot stage-2 USB loader]' renders on panel; prompt reached with autoboot off and nothing else running; panel alive 60 s; power-cycle returns enrolled loader + quiescent 'Running proxy' (handoff bar). KIS may observe m1n1 but success is panel-evidence only. STOP (record, release --state wedged if link in doubt) = any SError/exception/panic, freeze before banner, ANY storage/NVMe-related output (must be impossible — not compiled), panel dead >60 s, proxy absent after power-cycle (then DebugUSB recovery per COORDINATION). Prohibitions: no SPMI/PMU/charger/NVRAM/firmware writes, no APFS/Boot Policy, no usb start, one boot cycle only. READY gates before scheduling: independent exact-artifact review vs m1n1/AGENTS.md non-negotiables, pin DTB + composed-image SHA-256s (host dtc fixture 759d00ba is compile-check only, NOT a rig artifact), verify stage2 patch 814ffa47/defconfig 846b3178/config efd9ab2a hashes, dep 128 in done/. Expected result is boring by design: U-Boot cannot enumerate anything (Type-C answer NO; R3/096/097 NO-GO); this only proves the stage-2 USB stack is inert-safe as an m1n1 payload. Follow-up usb-probe PREBOOT variant is a separate future ticket, not this one.
